visualCharacteristics.structure: image-only slides, thumbnail nav with orange active underline, chevron arrows

contentPattern: One row per screenshot, a single cell with the image (with its alt text). No text cell. The block builds the thumbnail strip from the same images; do not author thumbnails separately.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only galleries that need a thumbnail picker (game screenshots). For linked promo banners use carousel-promo; for photo + text slides use carousel-winners.
